title: Graph Decompositions at the Integral Expectation Threshold
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove the graph-decomposition conjecture of Ascoli, He, Park, and Talagrand. Every graph admits a partition into a universally bounded number of fixed edge pieces, each having ordinary containment threshold at most a universal constant times the original graph's integral expectation threshold. The partition is chosen before sampling the random host, and the separate embeddings of the pieces need not agree on shared vertices.
titleEn: Graph Decompositions at the Integral Expectation Threshold
titleZh: 积分期望阈值处的图分解

details.overview: 稿件证明Ascoli、He、Park与Talagrand提出的图分解猜想。作者声称：每个图都可分解为固定边块，块数有通用上界；每块的普通包含阈值不超过原图积分期望阈值的通用常数倍。分解在随机宿主抽样之前选定，各块的嵌入无需在共享顶点上一致。该结果把图的阈值行为归约到有限个固定边块上。
keyPoints: 每图可分成通用有界数量的固定边块，各块阈值受原图积分期望阈值常数倍控制
